script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: “Sihon refuses Israel passage” is not shown to happen at Heshbon. Deuteronomy 2:26 says Moses sent messengers from the Wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon, king of Heshbon, but does not say where Sihon received them.
“Reuben and Gad ask for the land” is not shown to happen at Heshbon. Numbers 32:1–6 names Heshbon as part of the requested land but does not say where the request was made.
